name: 婴幼儿柔软卡通棉袜款
description: 多款随机配色卡通印花童袜，松紧袜口贴合，毛圈里料亲肤

styleLock.backgroundSystem: milk-white #FBF8F2 for packshot and texture shots, butter-yellow #F6E7A9 and blush-pink #F7E3E7 pastel fields for info and CTA shots, warm linen-beige #EFE7DA for lifestyle
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft warm studio lighting, gentle diffused front or upper-left key with fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte pastel paper field and soft linen-textured nursery surfaces
styleLock.iconSystem: simple rounded line icons in one accent color, kept minimal
styleLock.presentationRules: gentle product angles with consistent soft scale; socks always shown clean, uncropped and neatly folded or laid flat
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft nursery-basics visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of milk-white background #FBF8F2, butter-yellow accent field #F6E7A9, blush-pink accent #F3C0CC and warm cocoa-brown text #6B584A; bright soft warm studio lighting with gentle diffused keys and soft contact shadows; rounded friendly sans-serif typography; consistent simple rounded line icons in one accent color; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal pastel infographic elements; stable gentle product angles and consistent scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索首图一眼看清卡通棉袜形态，干净合规赢得点击
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level front view, pair folded upright and centered, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, soft front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A pair of the socks folded upright and centered, straight-on eye-level front view, full product visible and not clipped by the frame. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a soft front-left key and gentle fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the pair. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF, no props. The pair occupies 60-70% of the frame, no extra whitespace. Clean commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no model, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no branded character artwork or trademark graphics, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 一秒传达柔软舒适的核心利益，承接主图
shots.camera: from a high 45-degree angle looking down at the pair laid flat on the field
shots.lighting: soft diffused warm studio light from the upper left, gentle shadow
shots.whitespace: generous negative space in the upper-left 40% reserved for copy
shots.textZone: top-left headline zone: 「{selling_point_1}」 with one short label 「{callout_1}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The socks laid as a neat pair, photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down, occupying 50-60% of the frame in the lower right. Soft diffused warm studio light from the upper left with a gentle shadow. Butter-yellow pastel background #F6E7A9. Generous negative space in the upper-left 40% reserved for the headline 「{selling_point_1}」 and one short label 「{callout_1}」. Negative: no more than one claim, no invented fabric percentages or efficacy claims, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no branded character artwork or trademark graphics.

shots.intent: 放大硬袜口摩擦娇嫩皮肤的顾虑，用柔软对比引出解法
shots.camera: matched split-screen framing, straight-on eye-level with identical camera on both panels
shots.lighting: left panel flat and harsh, right panel soft and gentle
shots.textZone: bottom label strip per panel: 「{callout_1}」 left and 「{callout_2}」 right
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen with two matched panels, straight-on eye-level framing identical on both sides. Left panel: a tight harsh crop of a coarse stiff knitted cuff under flat harsh light, suggesting scratchy friction. Right panel: {product} with its soft elastic cuff resting relaxed in soft gentle light. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Blush-pink background #F9EDEF on both panels. Each sock occupies 50-60% of its panel, no extra whitespace. Small labels 「{callout_1}」 on the left and 「{callout_2}」 on the right. Negative: no real baby skin or model face, no fabricated test data or statistics, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no branded character artwork or trademark graphics.

shots.intent: 代入儿童房晾晒的生活场景，强化日常百搭好感
shots.camera: eye-level slight 3/4 view with a candid handheld feel
shots.lighting: warm morning window light from the left, 5500K, soft shadows
shots.props: jute string with small heart-shaped wooden clips, a woven basket hinted at the frame edge, not covering the product
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the right 35% for copy
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: several pairs of {product} hanging from a jute string held by small heart-shaped wooden clips against a soft nursery wall. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed at an eye-level slight 3/4 with a candid handheld feel. Warm morning window light from the left, 5500K, soft shadows. Warm linen-beige wall background #EFE7DA with a woven basket hinted at the frame edge, props never covering the product. The socks occupy 40-50% of the frame, generous negative space on the right 35% for the copy 「{selling_point_1}」. Negative: no people, no recognizable child face, no clutter, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no branded character artwork or trademark graphics.

shots.intent: 用微距毛圈纹理证明亲肤材质
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, tight zoom on the fabric, shallow depth of field with foreground sharp
shots.lighting: skimming side light from the right revealing loop texture and yarn softness
shots.whitespace: minimal, the texture is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the loop-terry inner surface and fine knit stitches of the fabric. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Macro lens look with shallow depth of field, foreground sharp. Skimming side light from the right revealing the loop texture and the softness of the yarn. Milk-white background #FBF8F2 softly out of focus. The texture fills 55-60% of the frame, minimal whitespace, the detail is the subject. Negative: no blurry subject, no invented fiber percentages, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no props.

shots.intent: 展示平整袜头缝与罗纹袜口，消除摩擦疑虑
shots.camera: directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, sock laid flat
shots.lighting: soft diffused light with a skimming accent from the left revealing the smooth flat seam
shots.promptTemplate: Close-up detail shot of {product}, tight zoom on the flat linked toe seam and the ribbed cuff edge. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle with the sock laid flat, the detail occupying 55-60% of the frame. Soft diffused light with a skimming accent from the left revealing the smooth flat seam. Powder-pink background #F7E3E7, minimal whitespace. A short label 「{callout_3}」 beside the seam with a thin pointer line. Negative: no invented sewing-technique claims, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no hands, no branded character artwork or trademark graphics.

shots.intent: 呈现多色随机搭配，让买家放心选择
shots.lighting: soft even high-key light, identical across all pairs, minimal shadows
shots.whitespace: even margins around the grid, no extra whitespace
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant grid of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A neat flat-lay grid of several pairs in different pastel prints and colors, photographed from a top-down 90-degree overhead angle, identical lighting across all pairs. Soft even high-key light with minimal shadows. Milk-white background #FBF8F2. The group occupies 60-70% of the frame overall with even margins around the grid, no extra whitespace. A headline band at the top reading 「{selling_point_2}」. Negative: no mixed lighting between pairs, no color drift between cells, no invented size charts, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no branded character artwork or trademark graphics.

shots.intent: 用留空参数卡与洗护图标降低决策风险
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level infographic layout, product upright on the left
shots.lighting: soft even high-key light, no dramatic shadow
shots.props: three rounded white info cards with blank value lines and a row of six minimal care line-icons with blank captions
shots.textZone: right spec column: 「{callout_4}」 「{callout_5}」 「{callout_6}」 with blank value lines
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic trust screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level layout with the sock pair upright on the left and a clean spec column on the right: three rounded white cards with blank label lines 「{callout_4}」 「{callout_5}」 「{callout_6}」 and empty value lines, plus a row of six minimal care line-icons with blank captions. Soft even high-key light, no dramatic shadow. Butter-yellow pastel background #F6E7A9. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame with structured margins around the cards. Negative: do NOT invent fabric percentages, certifications, test data or washing temperatures; no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no branded character artwork or trademark graphics.

shots.intent: 收口促单，给出行动按钮位置
shots.lighting: soft warm studio light from the upper left, gentle contact shadows
shots.props: a small woven basket with a few rolled pairs beside the main pair
shots.whitespace: generous negative space at the top 30% for banner copy
shots.textZone: top banner: 「{selling_point_3}」 plus rounded CTA button 「{callout_7}」
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The sock pair leaning softly against a small woven basket with a few rolled pairs beside it, photographed at a slight 3/4 eye-level view. Soft warm studio light from the upper left with gentle contact shadows. Blush-pink background #F9EDEF. The group occupies 50-60% of the frame in the lower half, generous negative space at the top 30% for the banner 「{selling_point_3}」 and a rounded CTA button reading 「{callout_7}」. Negative: no invented discounts, prices or countdowns, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no branded character artwork or trademark graphics, no hands.

provenance.notes: 9 屏事实：P1 黄格底毛笔字首屏与卷装卡通棉袜、藤篮收纳；P2 挂绳夹卡展示与棉含量文案（原文数值不采信）；P3 卷口特写与三个粉蓝绿圆形卖点及 TIPS 栏；P4 TIPS 文栏、戴帽婴儿图与织物纹理；P5 毛圈纹理微距、袜口/袜身结构说明与挂绳椭圆插画；P6 参数表（品牌品名留空、颜色随机、四季）与弹力/厚度/柔软指数、洗护图标及胡子形字标；P7-P9 藤篮平铺袜身印花、圆形微距插图与彩色插画分隔。判定依据：图为婴幼儿棉袜（袜口/袜身分区、弹力指数、贴身亲肤文案、松紧罗纹口与毛圈里料），属贴身穿着而非外穿服装，故判内衣家居服/儿童内衣而非母婴/童装。已剥离：原品牌字标与英文刺绣字样、棉含量百分比与各项指数数值、洗护温度数值、婴儿面部与卡通贴纸素材、原文案原句，产品一律以 {product} 占位，信任与参数项用空白占位。
